name: Martin Strohmeier
biography: Martin Strohmeier is a Senior Scientist at the Swiss Cyber Defence Campus, where he is responsible for vulnerability research programmes into aircraft, satellites and cars. His work was published in all major systems security conferences, totalling more than 100 publications to date. He has also spoken previously at the DEFCON Aerospace Village and co-organized CTFs there.
